note: Voice and face options for the interview. Prices and API details as listed on each provider's site on the date above. Edit names, voices, or notes here; API calls live in media.py.

browser.name: Browser built-in (free)
browser.note: Uses your browser's own speech recognition and voices. Works best in Chrome or Edge; voices sound robotic. Your speech is processed by the browser maker's servers (e.g. Google for Chrome).

openai.name: OpenAI
openai.price: Hearing you: $0.0045 per minute. Speaking: $12 per million audio tokens (roughly $0.25-0.50 per interview).
openai.note: Natural voices. OpenAI says the gpt-4o-mini-tts speaking model shuts down January 6, 2027; update tts_model in media.json when a successor is announced.

elevenlabs.name: ElevenLabs
elevenlabs.price: Speaking: $0.04 per 1,000 characters (v4 Turbo). Hearing you: $0.22 per hour.
elevenlabs.note: The most lifelike voices. Your account's voices are loaded automatically once the key is set.

deepgram.name: Deepgram
deepgram.price: Hearing you: $0.0043 per minute. Speaking: $0.030 per 1,000 characters. New accounts get $200 free credit.

builtin.name: Animated face (free)
builtin.note: A cartoon face drawn in your browser. It blinks, moves its mouth while talking, and changes expression with the witness's mood (nervous, defensive, calm...). Works with any voice service.

simli.name: Simli (lifelike video)

SIMLI_FACE_ID.label: Face ID from Simli's preset faces

simli.price: From $0.009 per minute. Free plan: 50 minutes a month.
simli.note: Lip-syncs a lifelike face to the witness's voice, so it needs OpenAI, ElevenLabs, or Deepgram as the voice service (not the browser's). Simli's site showed its API as temporarily paused on 2026-11-05; check before relying on it.

did.name: D-ID (lifelike video)

DID_SOURCE_URL.label: Public web link to a photo of the face to animate (jpg or png)

did.note: Animates a photo and speaks with D-ID's own voice. Uses D-ID's streaming API, which D-ID now labels as legacy, so it may stop working in future.

tavus.name: Tavus (lifelike video)

TAVUS_FACE_ID.label: Face ID (or replica ID) from your Tavus account

tavus.price: Plans from $59/month (175 minutes); about $0.26-$0.37 per extra minute.
tavus.note: Polished lifelike video. The app sends the witness's words for the Tavus face to say (Tavus's "echo" messages). Tavus documents echo for custom pipelines; whether it works on every face wasn't confirmed.

heygen.name: HeyGen (lifelike video, experimental)

HEYGEN_AVATAR_ID.label: Interactive avatar ID (optional; HeyGen picks one if blank)

heygen.note: Built from HeyGen's older Streaming Avatar documentation, because the current docs couldn't be reached. Expect it to need fixes before it works.
